SHB-A.ST.fundamentals_source: Yahoo quoteSummary via direct crumb fetch (fc.yahoo.com + getcrumb) - yfinance's own client fails on this network (curl_cffi TLS fingerprint gets connection-reset by Yahoo's anti-bot layer), plain urllib does not.
SHB-A.ST.note: Multi-year revenue is real (Yahoo's own reported fiscal-year figures). Free cash flow, capex, EBIT, ROIC, and invested capital are TRAILING-ONLY snapshots (single current figures, not multi-year series) - Yahoo's legacy cashflowStatementHistory/incomeStatementHistory modules don't expose real multi-year capex/EBIT lines. capex, ebit, and roic_pct below are DERIVED (see each field's calculation_method), not filed figures - for a real FCF/EBIT trend, use a company's own cash flow statement (PDF via the pdf skill).

ebit.calculation_method: operating_margins * total_revenue - Yahoo's own EBIT line (incomeStatementHistory) is broken/zero for this source, confirmed empirically, not fetched

interest_expense.calculation_method: not available from Yahoo quoteSummary for any ticker checked - needs a filing or PDF extract (source tier 1)

roic_pct.calculation_method: ebit*(1-tax_rate)/invested_capital, tax_rate=0.206 (assumed statutory rate for Sweden, NOT a real effective rate - no source provides one)
